description: This file defines the 'RetrieveSubjects' command class, which is used to retrieve Subjects based on a specific Policy ID and Label within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON strings or objects, and provides accessors for its properties, along with serialization logic.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjects
classes.description: Immutable command class used to retrieve Subjects associated with a specific Policy ID and Label. Supports creation from JSON, accessors, and serialization for messaging purposes.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a RetrieveSubjects instance with specified PolicyId, Label, and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create a RetrieveSubjects instance from a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create a RetrieveSubjects instance from a JsonObject.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Accessor for the Label associated with the Policy Entry.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId that this command targets.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Builds and returns the JsonPointer resource path for the Subjects within the JSON structure.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's payload (PolicyId and Label) into a JSON object for transmission.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare RetrieveSubjects instances.
